## 87739bb6a3d1

**Reproduced defect — override contract.** Generator SHA-256 `51569a144b3c4e940ff16c83e5bec154f366fd7dc74a0c73d42a87dd0b181de8` declares `grid_h` valid over 4..14 and `bridges` over 1..8, but easy seed 0 rejects `grid_h=4` against an internal 7..8 draw and rejects `bridges=8` against an internal 2..4 draw. It also accepts an unknown override key and returns an 8×8 grid. The supported override stage exits 1 and reports thousands of related findings plus undeclared multi-axis incompatibilities. No source was changed.

Compact reproducer: `checks/audit/87739bb6a3d1/counterexample.json`. Full supported evidence: `checks/audit-87739-override/result.json` and `checks/audit-87739-override/checks/87739bb6a3d1_after_override_results.json`.
